name: VERTIGO
desc:
We had a good run, eh? Thanks for playing, everyone!
If you wish to remake the game, all I simply ask of you is to use a different name and not directly rip assets, thank you!

VERTIGO is a Melee-focused PVP game that takes place on a distant planet in a dystopian future!

⚔️ FIGHT with your Fists or Weapons you find!
💣 AVOID Hazards such as Bomb Rain, Flooding, Trains, and Pitfalls!
🛡️ FIND Armor and other helpful items! 
📈 RISE to the top of the Global and Weekly leaderboards!
📢 TAUNT with a variety of emotes! (/e list in chat!)

🔒 SHIFT LOCK has been rebound to CTRL. 

📌 CREDITS are in the Settings menu In-game!
